address: Unit 13C, Liberty Wharf, La route de Liberation, St Helier, JE2 3NY, United Kingdom
bio: Overlooking Liberation Square, this buzzing restaurant takes inspiration from the chef’s time working in Spain. Ingredients from Jersey and the surrounding area meet techniques often associated with the Basque region; glowing hot coals and a wood-fired oven are both visible in the open kitchen, with a few counter seats available if you can stand the heat. From chops of turbot and ex-dairy cow to Ibérico ham collar, plenty of quality produce gets the fire-based treatment, in dishes that push natural flavours to the fore....
